items.event_time_ist: Wednesday, Oct 7, 2026 (~7:00 PM UTC Oct 7 / ~12:30 AM IST Oct 8; UKMTO Warning 158-26)
items.summary: A chemical/oil tanker was struck by multiple projectiles ~1900 UTC Oct 7 about 51 nautical miles north of Madinat ash Shamal, Qatar — UKMTO Warning 158-26, with casualties reported (numbers/severity undisclosed; authorities investigating). The vessel was later identified as the Acers, an Antigua and Barbuda-flagged chemical and oil tanker. This was the first tanker attack deep inside the Persian Gulf in nearly a month (since a Sep 9 strike southeast of Al-Faw, Iraq), a major escalation of the threat's geography: most October attacks have been in or near Hormuz, but this one landed ~500 km west of the strait. UKMTO did not attribute the attack. WSJ: Brent jumped ~5% past $105 on Thursday as traders feared the surge spreading beyond Hormuz and complicating US-backed shuttle-run shipping arrangements. Catch-up: this incident was missed by earlier checks and is back-filled here with the correct event date.
items.title: Chemical/oil tanker Acers struck by multiple projectiles off Qatar, Oct 7 — first deep-Gulf attack in nearly a month, casualties reported (missed by earlier checks; back-filled)
